title: khoke bhai ko aayi hai zainab
body:
khoke bhai ko aayi hai zainab
zulm kya kya uthaai hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
sar pe chaadar nahi thi baalo se
apna chehra chupaai hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
saath kunbe ko leke karbal se
dar badar phir ke aayi hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
thi jo bhai ki laadli duqtar
qabr uski banaai hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khule shaam aur koofa me
kya aziyat uthaai hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
leke 'saahil' nishaan rassi ke
maa ki turbat pe aayi hai zainab
